insights: The market has experienced a significant upward shift in the last four days, breaking out of the previous 1400-1500 range to establish a new floor near 1750.
Growth is primarily driven by non-FAANG/non-unicorn companies, suggesting a broader expansion in hiring activity beyond the traditional tech giants.

Software Engineering remains the dominant driver of volume, while niche roles like Frontend remain stagnant, indicating that hiring demand is currently focused on core infrastructure and product development.
